"""Hand-computed semantic expectations."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import run

def ok(): return {'status': 'ok'}
def un(): return {'status': 'unready'}
def busy(): return {'status': 'busy'}
def full(): return {'status': 'full'}

cases = []
def case(name, req, exp): cases.append((name, json.dumps(req), exp))

F1 = {'id': 'f', 'path': ['s0', 's1', 'r'], 'template': 'aabbcc1100020500',
      'kinds': 'KKKDZQTK', 'labels': [16, 20, 16]}
F2 = {'id': 'g', 'path': ['s0', 's1', 'r'], 'template': '1111111100020500',
      'kinds': 'KKKDZQTK', 'labels': [16, 20, 16]}
F3 = {'id': 'h', 'path': ['s0', 'r'], 'template': 'aabbccdd00000500',
      'kinds': 'KKKDDDZQT', 'labels': [16, 16]}

# A: overwrite / busy / enable ordering
ev = [{'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'g', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's1'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 'r'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'g', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'disable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'g', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'g'}]
case('overwrite-busy', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 1, 's1': 1, 'r': 1},
                        'flows': [F1, F2], 'events': ev},
     {'results': [ok(), ok(), un(), ok(), un(), ok(), un(), ok(), ok(), busy(), ok(),
                  ok(), un(), ok()],
      'active': ['g'],
      'tables': [{'node': 'r', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'f'},
                 {'node': 's0', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'g'},
                 {'node': 's1', 'label': 20, 'flow': 'f'}]})

# B: full at capacity, overwrite does not consume a slot
ev = [{'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'h', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'h', 'node': 's1'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'h', 'node': 'r'}]
case('full-boundary', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 1, 's1': 5, 'r': 5},
                       'flows': [F1, F3], 'events': ev},
     {'results': [ok(), full(), ok(), ok(), ok()], 'active': [],
      'tables': [{'node': 'r', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'h'},
                 {'node': 's0', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'f'},
                 {'node': 's1', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'h'}]})

# C: zero-capacity node can hold nothing
ev = [{'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 'r'}, {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'}]
case('zero-capacity', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 2, 's1': 2, 'r': 0},
                       'flows': [F1], 'events': ev},
     {'results': [full(), un()], 'active': [], 'tables': []})

# D: idempotent puts and enable of enabled flow
ev = [{'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's0'}, {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's0'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's1'}, {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 'r'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'}, {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's1'}, {'op': 'disable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'disable', 'flow': 'f'}, {'op': 'reset'}]
case('idempotent', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 2, 's1': 2, 'r': 2},
                    'flows': [F1], 'events': ev},
     {'results': [ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(), ok()],
      'active': [], 'tables': [
          {'node': 'r', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'f'},
          {'node': 's0', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'f'},
          {'node': 's1', 'label': 20, 'flow': 'f'}]})

# E: same label reused at different nodes and by different flows
ev = [{'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's0'}, {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 's1'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'f', 'node': 'r'}, {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'f'},
      {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'h', 'node': 's0'}, {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'h', 'node': 'r'},
      {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'h'}]
case('label-reuse-busy', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 5, 's1': 5, 'r': 5},
                          'flows': [F1, F3], 'events': ev},
     {'results': [ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(), busy(), busy(), un()], 'active': ['f'],
      'tables': [{'node': 'r', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'f'},
                 {'node': 's0', 'label': 16, 'flow': 'f'},
                 {'node': 's1', 'label': 20, 'flow': 'f'}]})

# F: byte-level codec with Z/D/K/Q/T spread out
FH = {'id': 'z', 'path': ['s0', 's1', 'r'], 'template': '0190af0c5b3e21d0ff0e',
      'kinds': 'ZDKQDDZKKT', 'labels': [100, 200, 100]}
PK = {'op': 'packet', 'flow': 'z', 'header': '00aaff04010203d0ff05', 'payload': 'cafe'}
setup = [{'op': 'put', 'flow': 'z', 'node': 's0'}, {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'z', 'node': 's1'},
         {'op': 'put', 'flow': 'z', 'node': 'r'}, {'op': 'enable', 'flow': 'z'}]
case('codec-mpls', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 1, 's1': 1, 'r': 1},
                    'flows': [FH], 'events': setup + [PK]},
     {'results': [ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(),
                  {'mode': 'mpls', 'reason': 'compressed',
                   'wire': ['00064905aa0102cafe', '000c8904aa0102cafe', '00064903aa0102cafe'],
                   'delivered': '00aaff04010200d0ff03cafe', 'byte_hops': 27}],
      'active': ['z'],
      'tables': [{'node': 'r', 'label': 100, 'flow': 'z'},
                 {'node': 's0', 'label': 100, 'flow': 'z'},
                 {'node': 's1', 'label': 200, 'flow': 'z'}]})
case('codec-ip', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 1, 's1': 1, 'r': 1},
                  'flows': [FH], 'events': [PK]},
     {'results': [{'mode': 'ip', 'reason': 'disabled',
                   'wire': ['00aaff04010203d0ff05cafe', '00aaff04010203d0ff04cafe',
                            '00aaff04010203d0ff03cafe'],
                   'delivered': '00aaff04010203d0ff03cafe', 'byte_hops': 36}],
      'active': [], 'tables': []})
for ttl, nlinks, bh in ((0, 0, 0), (1, 1, 9), (2, 2, 18), (3, 3, 27)):
    hdr = '00aaff04010203d0ff%02x' % ttl
    wire = []
    for i in range(nlinks):
        val = ((100 if i != 1 else 200) << 12) | (4 << 9) | 256 | (ttl - i)
        wire.append(val.to_bytes(4, 'big').hex() + 'aa0102' + 'cafe')
    if nlinks == 3:
        dl = '00aaff04010200d0ff%02xcafe' % (ttl - 2)
    else:
        dl = None
    case('codec-ttl%d' % ttl, {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 1, 's1': 1, 'r': 1},
                               'flows': [FH], 'events': setup + [
            {'op': 'packet', 'flow': 'z', 'header': hdr, 'payload': 'cafe'}]},
         {'results': [ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(),
                      {'mode': 'mpls', 'reason': 'compressed', 'wire': wire,
                       'delivered': dl, 'byte_hops': bh}],
          'active': ['z'] if False else ['z'],
          'tables': [{'node': 'r', 'label': 100, 'flow': 'z'},
                     {'node': 's0', 'label': 100, 'flow': 'z'},
                     {'node': 's1', 'label': 200, 'flow': 'z'}]})

# G: classification order: mismatch beats qos; qos beats compressed
def pkt(hdr):
    return {'op': 'packet', 'flow': 'z', 'header': hdr, 'payload': ''}
case('classify', {'mode': 'replay', 'capacities': {'s0': 1, 's1': 1, 'r': 1},
                  'flows': [FH], 'events': setup + [pkt('01aaff04010203d0ff05'),
                                                    pkt('00aaff04010203d0ff06'),
                                                    pkt('00aaffff04010203d0ff07'),
                                                    pkt('00aaff04010203d0ff08'),
                                                    pkt('00aaff04010203d0ff09')]},
     {'results': [ok(), ok(), ok(), ok(),
                  {'mode': 'ip', 'reason': 'mismatch', 'wire': [], 'delivered': None, 'byte_hops': 0},
                  {'mode': 'ip', 'reason': 'mismatch', 'wire': [], 'delivered': None, 'byte_hops': 0},
                  {'mode': 'ip', 'reason': 'mismatch', 'wire': [], 'delivered': None, 'byte_hops': 0},
                  {'mode': 'ip', 'reason': 'qos', 'wire': [], 'delivered': None, 'byte_hops': 0},
                  {'mode': 'mpls', 'reason': 'compressed',
                   'wire': ['00064905aa0102cafe'.replace('cafe', ''), ], 'delivered': None,
                   'byte_hops': 0}],
      'active': ['z'],
      'tables': [{'node': 'r', 'label': 100, 'flow': 'z'},
                 {'node': 's0', 'label': 100, 'flow': 'z'},
                 {'node': 's1', 'label': 200, 'flow': 'z'}]})

def main():
    reqs = [c[1] for c in cases]
    got = run(reqs)
    fails = 0
    for (name, _l, exp), g in zip(cases, got):
        if g != exp:
            fails += 1
            print('FAIL', name)
            print('  exp', json.dumps(exp))
            print('  got', json.dumps(g))
    print('cases', len(cases), 'failures', fails)

main()
EOF
